Subject: bend issue on Line 2 near Fort McMurray
Just got off site at the 24" bend on Line 2, about 2 km west of the Fort McMurray yard.
Maintenance crew was doing a routine walkover at 14:30 when they noticed the backfill over
the bend had settled uneven-about 18" drop over 4 m. Looks like some sort of ground
movement or maybe water got in. The bend itself is still buried, but the sag is right over it.
One of the guys slipped on the loose dirt and jammed his finger pretty bad-ambulance took
him to the clinic. No product released, everything holding pressure. Need someone to check
if this is just normal settlement or if we've got a bigger geotech issue.
Let me know how you want to handle it.
Dave
Field Operator, Okanagan Crossing Pipelines Ltd.
